question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party through extensive purges of military and party elites in 2025–2026, which have eliminated potential rivals and reinforced loyalty within the Central Committee and PLA. With no designated successor and institutional norms altered to permit extended tenure, analysts widely anticipate his continuation into a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027. At age 73, Xi faces no immediate term-limit pressures or visible elite challenges before then. Trader consensus at 95.9% for "No" reflects this entrenched position and the absence of disruptive events. Low-probability shifts could still arise from a sudden health event, unprecedented internal factional realignment, or unforeseen policy crisis forcing early retirement.
